premises.text: Businesses spend billions on engineering costs to manage servers on AWS.
premises.evidence_span: Every year, businesses spend billions of dollars in engineering costs just to manage servers on AWS.

premises.text: Hosting applications on traditional cloud providers is tedious and error-prone.
premises.evidence_span: Building these apps was easy, but hosting them was agonizing. I had to spin up VMs, install networking, set up SSL, and a ton of other things for every single app.

premises.text: Render automates the deployment of applications without managing servers.
premises.evidence_span: Render is a completely automated cloud provider. Render lets you deploy anything from a simple static site to complex application clusters, and you can do it faster than on any other cloud and without managing servers at all.

premises.text: Render integrates into existing workflows by automating code deployment.
premises.evidence_span: Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there.

premises.text: Render provides built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing.
premises.evidence_span: every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing.

premises.text: Render offers SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores.
premises.evidence_span: Render is the first fully managed cloud to offer SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores.

premises.text: Render allows infrastructure updates by pushing a single file to Git.
premises.evidence_span: You can update your infrastructure by simply pushing this file to Git.

premises.text: Render is more cost-effective than competitors like Heroku.
premises.evidence_span: Just two gigabytes of RAM costs $250 a month on Heroku, compared to $25 a month on Render.

premises.text: The platform as a service market is worth $20 billion and growing.
premises.evidence_span: Right now, we're focused on the platform as a service market worth $20 billion.

premises.text: Render's revenue has grown organically by over 50% month over month.
premises.evidence_span: Render's revenue has grown by over 50% month over month for the last six months straight.

value.text: Developers can automate cloud hosting and save on engineering costs.
value.evidence_span: if you're a developer or founder who's frustrated with AWS or Heroku and you're looking to save big on engineering costs, automate your cloud hosting today by signing up on Render.
